title: Task System
description: A file-persisted task graph tracks status, ownership, and blockedBy dependencies.

steps.content: Break the release into tasks and block deployment until tests pass.
steps.annotation: The user asks for durable multi-step coordination.
The first phase creates task nodes without dependencies.
The host returns the runtime-generated ID after the tool executes.
Sibling create calls do not guess or predeclare IDs.
The second node receives a different host-generated ID.
The second phase adds an edge using IDs returned by create_task.
The runtime validates and persists the dependency graph.
The claim fails until dependencies are complete.
The task graph prevents premature work.
The unblocked prerequisite is claimed before work begins.
Claim moves the task from pending to in_progress.
Completing a dependency can unblock downstream tasks.
